response.original_title: Nihon Kaidan Gekijō: The Peony Lantern — Onibi no Maki / Hotarubi no Maki
response.overview: Nobuo Nakagawa’s two-part adaptation of San’yūtei Enchō’s classic ghost tale follows the doomed romance between Shinzaburō and Otsuyu, whose death does not end their relationship. As Otsuyu’s spirit returns night after night, the greed of their neighbour Banzo sets in motion a widening chain of betrayal, murder and supernatural revenge.
